name: obsidianwork
description: Local workbench that mirrors an Obsidian vault in real time: CRM, decision log, knowledge navigator with wikilinks, full-text search, assets browser, and a safe write-back layer (append-only + byte-level backups + one-click restore, note creation undoes into .trash). Built to stay stable on mechanical disks.

scripts.check: node --check server.js && node --check lib/vault.js && node --check lib/watcher.js && node --check lib/api.js && node --check lib/config.js && node --check lib/writers.js && node --check scripts/smoke-test.cjs
scripts.check:web: for f in web/js/app.js web/js/util.js web/js/md.js web/js/views/overview.js web/js/views/captures.js web/js/views/clients.js web/js/views/client.js web/js/views/decisions.js web/js/views/knowledge.js web/js/views/note.js web/js/views/search.js web/js/views/assets.js web/js/views/system.js; do node --input-type=module --check < "$f" || exit 1; done
